IGUI_HUB_LWS_Desc: Your wardrobe: fashion pieces you keep forever, worn over your real clothes.
UI_options_HARMONIE_LWS_key_tooltip: A key that opens or closes the Life With Style window.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_What_Body: Fashion pieces are clothes for the look only. They never spawn in the world: the server's admins give them, or you trade them with other players. They belong to you - your account - not to your character: they never drop, can not be stolen, and stay when you die. Only Life With Style's own pieces go in the wardrobe - never items of other mods.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Dress_Body: The Dress up tab is a paper doll: 18 boxes around a figure, each with a dotted line to its place on the body, and your pieces beside it. Drag a piece onto its box to wear it (it only fits its own box), or just click it. Drag a worn piece off its box, right-click the box, or press Take off to take it off. Click a box to see only its pieces. The small-window button in the header shrinks the window to the doll and your pieces, so you can move it aside and watch your character while you dress. Pieces weigh nothing and protect nothing - your real clothes do that.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Show_Body: By default a worn piece hides your real clothes of that slot - they are still worn, keep protecting you and keep you warm, they are just not drawn, so nothing pokes through. "Real clothes: shown" draws them too, under the piece.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Death_Body: The wardrobe is kept on the server. When you die nothing of it goes into the body; your next character is dressed again the same way as soon as it spawns.

IGUI_LWS_Guide_Trade_Body: Open the Trade tab and ask a player online. When they accept, each of you clicks pieces of your own collection to offer them. Any change cancels both agreements; when you both press Agree on the same offer, the server swaps the pieces at once (a worn piece you give away is taken off). Nothing can be copied or lost. Only Life With Style pieces can be traded - never items of other mods.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Admin_Body: The Give tab is shown only to admins and to a game started with -debug. Pick the player who gets it on the left (Me = yourself; online players first), choose Fashion or Gacha items, then click an item in the catalog to give one. Click x on something the player owns to take it back. In multiplayer the server checks again and gives only for admins: -debug on your own game is not enough there. The HARMONIE debug right-click has a shortcut and a whole test set.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Pet_Body:
A pet is a wardrobe piece of the Pet box (by the doll's feet). Put it on and your dog or cat comes out beside you and follows you; take it off and it goes back to the wardrobe. It also goes away when you die or leave, and comes back when you return.

Right-click your pet (or anywhere): Pet, Feed, Orders (Follow, Stay, Come here, Make a sound) and Put away; the Pet box has the same buttons. Anyone may pet anyone's pet. Food: canned or dry dog food and dry cat food fill it up completely; any other food you carry fills it by how filling it is (bread, meat, beans...); rotten or poisoned food is refused. A cat sits down and grooms itself when it waits, and curls up after a while. If hunger is on (sandbox) a pet gets hungry over time, and a starving pet ignores orders until it is fed.

A pet never attacks anyone and nothing can hurt it. If it gets left far behind, or you change floors, it comes to you. Admins can switch pets, orders, feeding and hunger on or off in the sandbox options. The dogs and cats are the art of the Companion Dogs mod and its CD: Cats add-on, used with the author's permission.

IGUI_LWS_PetFoodInfo: Dog food (canned, open can, dry bag) and dry cat food fill a pet up completely. Any other food you carry works too, filling it by how filling that food is (bread, meat, a can of beans...). Rotten or poisoned food is refused. One item at a time; the pet must be out.

IGUI_LWS_Guide_Gacha_Body:
Gacha items are given by the server's admins, like fashion. They never go in your inventory and can not be dropped: open the Gacha items tab, click an item to read what it does, then press Use. Search by name or effect, or pick a category.

Medical and body items work at once. Manuals and field guides raise XP for real minutes; only one training manual at a time. Capsules last 30 minutes and only one capsule is active at a time - a new one replaces the old one. Survival journeys give flat XP at once. The New Dawn set is equipped, not used up: each piece adds XP on every skill, and all four make it x1.10.

The icons on the right of the screen show what is running; hover for the timers. Buffs end when your character dies.
IGUI_LWS_Guide_Soon_Body: A Discord-linked wardrobe, and fashion for pets.
